notes: Integrated GitHub transport reliability milestone. Generated Android source is uploaded only to an isolated generated-project branch while the trusted generated-project build workflow remains on the repository default branch and is triggered via repository_dispatch. On-device GitHub preflight now validates repository access, the default branch, trusted workflow visibility/state, and Actions-read access before source upload. Fine-grained token guidance is reduced to the practical minimum for this path: repository Contents read/write plus Actions read; Workflows write is not required. GitHub failures now preserve exact AUTH 401, PERMISSION 403, REPOSITORY/WORKFLOW 404, BRANCH, workflow-discovery, build, and artifact errors in the project CI state. The structured plan -> real source tree -> generated files -> user-authorized GitHub build -> CI observation -> bounded repair/rebuild -> installable APK path, persistent project state, AIDao-owned task states, Android inset/IME behavior, readable functional typography, and user-controlled update boundary remain preserved.
